summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, initially treated the brief cautiously, then explicitly upgraded "bounded → architectural" after my clarifying answers, ran the full design Q&A, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-identity-design.md, presented it for review, and only began planning/implementation after I approved.
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria were satisfied and verified against both the screen and the on-disk artifacts/session log. Incidental issues (stub Codex gate reported as preflight-ok, spec gitignored) are noted but do not violate the criteria.

observations.description: Codex review gate degraded silently-ish: agent reported 'Codex spec gate degraded [status: not-ready]. Preflight reported ok, but the installed companion is 0.0.0-stub and returned an empty response for both the approach gate and this spec review.' Preflight saying ok while the companion is a non-functional stub looks like a preflight check bug.

The agent added a repo-level .gitignore containing 'docs/superpowers' and 'docs/hyperpowers', so the spec it just wrote is untracked/ignored. Un-asked-for change to the repo, and it means the spec is never committed with the work.
Structure question recommended converting to ES modules, which the agent itself noted breaks opening index.html via file:// — a workflow-breaking change presented as the default 'Recommended' option.
Multi-question form widget: after checking a checkbox answer it isn't obvious you must Tab to a separate 'Submit' tab; easy to get stuck pressing Enter.
Long think pauses (up to ~3 minutes, 'Crunched for 2m 56s') with the screen appearing frozen between turns.

criteria.evidence: Session log grep: '"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"' appears before any workdir file writes; first workdir Write in log is the spec file, later .gitignore.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec to docs/.../specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Upgrading bounded → architectural. "Persists across the app" ... That's a new subsystem, not a parameter on one stub. ... we'll do the full process'. File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-identity-design.md ('# User Identity Layer — Design').

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-identity-design.md ... Please review it and let me know if you want changes before I write the implementation plan.' git status showed only '?? .gitignore' — index.html/app.js unmodified at approval time.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Agent explicitly said 'Upgrading bounded → architectural. ... The ratchet is one-way' and produced the spec file rather than an in-chat-only design.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No mention of spike or throwaway probe on screen; flow went questions → approaches → sectioned design → spec doc → writing-plans skill ('Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans)').
